data.title:
50% extra trade credit towards New Releases
					New Release titles are eligible up to two weeks after launch
data.fineprint: In store only. Eligible titles are for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Xbox Series X & PS5. Offer valid only towards games normally accepted in trade. Games must include original cases and artwork. Extra trade should cover up to the cost of the game purchased. Extra trade is to be put towards new release games. Cannot be combined with any other trade offer including EDGE. No duplicate titles accepted. Trades must be in full working condition to receive full value. Subject to Manager approval. Offer subject to change at any time.

data.title: Save $50 on USED Nintendo Switch Consoles
data.fineprint: Offer valid in store & online. Cannot be combined with any other offers. Can be combined with EDGE. Excludes Nintendo Switch 2. Quantity and selection may vary by store. Offer subject to change at any time. No substitutions will be made. No rainchecks.
